# Ratel Lumina
English · 中文
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ratel-works/dsh-lumina) [](LICENSE)
**Make development more fun.**
Ratel Lumina is a visual and motion enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness, available on desktop an
d Web / PWA clients. From navigation and running sessions to typing and sending, it adds a subtle la
yer of motion to everyday development.
## Why Lumina
- **Connected interactions.** Panels, menus, dialogs and message transitions flow together, while li

ght and color bring running sessions to life.
- **Your own style.** Choose the brand finish, colors,

motion intensity and send effect. Each effect can be switched off individually.
- **Native browser
capabilities.** No additional animation framework, with support for system reduced-motion preference
pabilities.** No additional animation framework, with support for system reduced-motion preferences.
Lumina does not change models, requests or message content, delay submission, or block typing, click
ange models, requests or message content, delay submission, or block typing, clicking and selection.

**After updating the plugin, fully quit and reopen the client** to load the new code. To update from

## Settings
Open **Lumina / 流光** in DSH settings. Saved changes apply immediately, without restarting.
- **Effects and style.** Choose colors, motion intensity and a send effect, or turn individual effec

ts off.
- **Performance and quality.** Choose **Performance**, **Balanced**, **Quality** or **Ultra*
*; Balanced is the default. Profiles adjust drawing frequency, resolution and detail independently o
f motion intensity. Hover or focus a profile button to see its parameters. Frame rates are limits, n

ot guarantees, and depend on your device and display.
- **Turning motion off.** The master switch re
stores the original interface. When system reduced motion is enabled, Lumina reduces or disables ani
mations automatically.
## Support
This is a plugin I built for myself, released in the open. The whole point is to make tedious develo
pment a little more fun. If you find it useful too, you can buy me a coffee:

- Afdian — WeChat Pay or Alipay
- Ko-fi — PayPal, card
